(define *session* (hash "id" 2 "fd" 9 "alive" #t "seq" 0))
(define gate (lambda (q) q))
(define tick (lambda (book sess) (hash "q" 0 "sess" (hash "id" (hash-ref sess "id") "fd" (hash-ref sess "fd") "alive" (hash-ref sess "alive") "seq" (+ (hash-ref sess "seq") 1)))))

(define *session* (hash "id" 3 "fd" 11 "alive" #t "seq" 0))
(define gate (lambda (q) q))
(define tick (lambda (book sess) (hash "q" (- (hash-ref book "ask") (hash-ref book "bid")) "sess" sess)))
